name: System
description: This computer's load, disk and busiest processes, and the ports something listens on: two panels and a status item, shell commands only.

sidebarPanels.title: Processes
sidebarPanels.command: uptime; echo; df -h . | sed 1d | awk '{print "Disk  " $5 " used, " $4 " free"}'; echo; ps -Ao pcpu,pmem,comm | sed 1d | sort -rn | head -12 | awk '{n = split($3, path, "/"); printf "\033[33m%5s%%\033[0m %5s%%  %s\n", $1, $2, path[n]}'

statusItems.label: Load average
statusItems.command: l=$(uptime | sed 's/.*load averages*: //' | awk '{gsub(",",""); print $1}') && printf '\357\203\244 %s\nLoad average over the last minute. Click for the busiest processes.\n' "$l"
